verdict.rationale: No data-export feature is documented. The 'leave' half is indirectly supported: the OpenAI-compatible API means code moves elsewhere with only a base-URL change, and pay-as-you-go with no long-term contracts lowers switching barriers. The zero-retention policy also implies little user prompt/output data is held. Missing for 10: any documented export tool or open-format dump of account data (usage logs, billing history, deployed fine-tuned weights, configurations), and any hands-on or independent evidence of a clean exit.
